title: [P0] Diet Plan phase suggestion can invert goal direction and prescribe unsafe kcal
description: Released Diet Plan phase-change acceptance can create an internally contradictory active goal. GoalSuggestionService.applyPhaseChange changes trajectory from cut to bulk/maintain based on a linked mesocycle goalPreset, but keeps startWeightKg/targetWeightKg unchanged. GoalFeasibilityService derives an unsigned magnitude via abs(start-target), then GoalProjectionService applies the new trajectory sign. Example visible in the Goal screenshot: HÍZÁS with 84.2 kg start and 78 kg target yields a positive bulk surplus and 3878 kcal. GoalPopulator and acceptance tests also permit bulk with a lower target, so CI does not catch the invariant violation. Present in Diet Plan release commit fd8c9e44d and v2.153.1 ancestry.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Goal create/update and phase-suggestion accept enforce a coherent trajectory/weight invariant (cut target < start; bulk target > start; maintain target absent or equal per decided contract). 2) A preset mismatch cannot silently reuse an opposite-direction target; acceptance either rejects with a typed 4xx, requires a coherent target decision, or creates a coherent transition per approved UX. 3) Existing contradictory rows are detected and repaired/fail-safe without emitting a deficit/surplus in the wrong direction. 4) Integration tests reproduce the 84.2 -> 78 + bulk case through the HTTP/suggestion path and prove safe behavior. 5) Goal/Fuel living docs and OpenAPI contract are updated if the boundary changes.
notes: Implemented on feat/goal-direction-invariant: shared trajectory/weight and minimum-window validator across CRUD, preview, and suggestion acceptance; legacy incoherent goals fail safe by clearing prescription/bootstrap. Focused backend suites green (54 + 47 tests), docs lint 0 errors.

title: Mock fuel timeline is ambient-clock coupled — timelineHooks test only passes in daytime hours
description:
`timelineHooks.test.tsx` > `useFuelTimeline / useFuelPreview (mock mode)` > "composes a deterministic COMPUTED plan (no static seed)" fails whenever the suite runs outside roughly 06:00–21:00 **in the runner's timezone**. CI runs in UTC, so any merge attempt in the late-UTC/early-UTC hours fails the `test-frontend` job on the clock rather than on the code. Hit while merging S6 (PR #459) at ~00:20 UTC; reproduced locally at 02:20 CEST; the test file is byte-identical to main's, so this is pre-existing and unrelated to that branch.

The failing assertion is the `pending` one:

```
expect(plan.slots.some(s => s.slotKey && s.state === 'pending')).toBe(true) // later windows stay pending
```

## The real defect, not just a flaky test

The last test in that same block asserts the intended contract explicitly:

```
// Mock mode pins the demo clock (spec D6) — the page must never read Date.now().
expect(result.current.nowHHmm).toBe('13:30')
```

So mock mode injects `now = 13:30`, and the block's comment claims the plan is deterministic ("no ambient clock/random"). It is not: the slot **states** and even the slot **times** move with the ambient clock. Pinning the ambient clock to 13:30 with `vi.useFakeTimers({toFake:['Date']})` does not make the fixed expectations hold — it produces a *different* plan again:

```
[["06:45","wake",null,"done"],["06:50","preworkout",null,"pending"],["07:30","workout",null,"done"],
 ["09:15","meal","breakfast","done"],["09:18","snack",null,"done"],["13:00","meal","lunch","done"],
 ["14:38","midday",null,"pending"],["18:11","snack","snack","now"],["21:15","evening",null,"pending"],
 ["23:35","meal","dinner","done"]]
```

Note the composed times (14:38, 18:11, 21:15, 23:35) and that every `pending` slot has a null `slotKey` — which is exactly why the assertion fails. The comment's claim of "exactly one `now` slot at 13:30" does not describe what the code produces.

So there are two things wrong, and the second is the one that matters:
1. the test has fixed expectations with no pinned clock, and
2. mock-mode plan composition reads the ambient clock even though the same block asserts it must not — meaning the demo/mock day is not actually deterministic.

## Fix

Make mock-mode composition consume the injected `now` (the same value `nowHHmm` reports) everywhere slot times and states are derived, instead of reading the ambient clock. Then the block's fixed expectations become true at any hour and the test needs no fake timers at all. Do NOT paper over it by tuning the fixture to whatever pinned time happens to pass — that hides the coupling rather than removing it, and this epic has already been bitten twice by fixtures parked at a value that masks the bug.

Same family as the other wall-clock-dependent tests (mezo-8d37, mezo-phib, and the medication cycle-day one filed today), but this one is a product-behaviour bug rather than only a fixture problem, hence P1.
notes: Not a real defect after all — resolved by merging main. main had already fixed this exact test in f0688063d 'fix(fuel): align mock timeline assertion with meal fixture (mezo-5b4r)'; our branch was simply 72 commits behind and predated that fix. The 'ambient-clock coupling' reading in the original report was wrong: buildDayPlan is genuinely clock-free and nowHHmm is injected and pinned in mock (MOCK_NOW_HHMM). Verified after the merge: timelineHooks.test.tsx green in both modes, full FE suite 668/668 files (5536 mock / 5537 real).

title: Deploy pipeline: compute-release.sh exit 141 (SIGPIPE) — a main deployjai buknak
description:
A main deploy workflowja visszatérően bukik a `version` jobban, MIELŐTT bármit kiírna.

BIZONYÍTÉK (2026-09-05, az utolsó négy main-merge deployja):
  #454 → run 33931158433 → exit 141
  #448 → run 33930625830 → exit 141
  #447 → run 33928928683 → exit 141
  #449 → sikeres
Mindhárom bukás UGYANAZ: `Run bash .github/scripts/compute-release.sh` → exit 141.

A 141 = 128+13 = SIGPIPE. A szkript 0,35 mp alatt hal meg, és EGYETLEN sort sem ír a
stderr-re (a `main()` végi `Resolved v... ` üzenet sem jelenik meg), tehát nagyon korán bukik.

MIÉRT NEM A KÉZENFEKVŐ OK: elsőre a `git tag -l 'v*' --sort=-v:refname | head -n1` sorra
gyanakodtam, de az kizárható — a tag-lista mindössze 4112 bájt (498 tag), ami bőven a 64 KB-os
cső-puffer alatt van, tehát a `git tag` be tudja fejezni az írást, mielőtt a `head` zár.

ERŐSEBB HIPOTÉZIS (nem bizonyított): a szkript `set -euo pipefail` alatt fut, és a
`compute_bump()` a stdin olvasása KÖZBEN térhet vissza (`echo "major"; return 0`), amikor egy
breaking-change sort talál. Ilyenkor a csővezeték FELSŐ fele (a `git log`, ami a commiteket
tolja bele) SIGPIPE-ot kap, és a `pipefail` miatt a 141 a teljes pipeline kilépőkódja lesz.
Ugyanez a minta a `printf ... | grep -qE` párosoknál is fennáll.

HATÁS: a deployok nem futnak le. Az ADR 0007 szerint a deploy NINCS a ci.yml-hez kötve, tehát
ez csendben történik — a ci.yml zöld marad, miközben semmi nem megy ki.

NEM JAVÍTOTTAM: a diagnózis nincs lezárva (a fenti hipotézis nem bizonyított), és egy vaktában
írt javítás a release-útvonalon rosszabb, mint egy pontosan dokumentált hiba. A következő lépés:
a `version` jobba egy `bash -x` futtatás vagy a pipeline-ok szétszedése, hogy kiderüljön, MELYIK
sor adja a 141-et.

MEGJEGYZÉS: nem az éjszakai munka okozta — a #447 és #448 deployja már előtte is így bukott.

title: Deploy race can tag unbuilt main contents
description: Rapid consecutive main merges expose a CI/CD race: a queued deploy builds images from an older event SHA, then release rebases its manifest commit onto the newest main. The release tag therefore contains later frontend/backend trees that were never included in the image. Subsequent deploy runs compare against that tag, report fe=false/be=false, and skip the missing builds. Observed on 2026-09-04: run 33920695717 built from ca82135, rebased release v2.163.0 onto 58608d475 (including PRs #436 and #435), while runs for intervening merges were cancelled/skipped.
design: Investigate release commit-back rebasing versus event-SHA image provenance. Prefer making the tag/release source immutable or recomputing/building from the final head; do not paper over with routine force builds.
acceptance_criteria: A regression test reproduces multiple rapid main merges; release commits/tags never claim source trees absent from built images; all changed components across queued merges are built exactly once or safely rebuilt; deployment documentation explains the concurrency invariant and recovery; CI and deploy validation are green.

title: Prod belépés a single-user korszak után: owner-fiók azonosítása és jelszó-reset (nem törlés!)
design:
HELYZET (2026-09-04): a felhasznalo nem tud belepni a prod appba, mert a bejelentkezes
mostantol email+jelszo (S1, mezo-qw37.1), es a single-user korszakbol nem tudja a
belepesi adatait.

FONTOS TENY, AMIT ELLENORIZTUNK A KODBAN — VALOSZINULEG NEM KELL SEM TORLES, SEM UJRAKOTES:

- Az app_user tabla NEM az S1-gyel jott letre: mar a 202606101200_mezo-v67_create_auth.sql
  ota letezik, email + password_hash + name oszlopokkal (single-user korszak).
- Az S1 changeset (202609021200_mezo-qw37.1_multi_user_accounts.sql:15-16) csak ALTER-t
  csinal, es kifejezetten backfillel:
    "-- Backfill: every pre-existing account is the founder — owner role, already onboarded."
    UPDATE app_user SET role = 'OWNER', onboarded_at = COALESCE(onboarded_at, created_at);
- Az osszes owned tabla created_by oszlopa mar eddig is erre az egy app_user sorra mutat.

=> A prod adatbazisban nagy valoszinuseggel MAR LETEZIK a felhasznalo fiokja, OWNER
   szerepkorrel, es MAR HOZZA VAN KOTVE minden adat. Csak a jelszo/email ismeretlen.

AMI ZAVART OKOZ: az OwnerSeedData @Profile("demodata") — tehat prodban SOHA nem fut le,
es nem hoz letre fiokot. A MEZO_OWNER_EMAIL / MEZO_OWNER_PASSWORD env valtozok
(OwnerProperties, mezo.auth.*) prodban CSAK a jwtSecret miatt kellenek, fiokot nem seedelnek.

TEENDO — ebben a sorrendben, NE ugorj a torlesre:

1. Diagnozis prod DB-n (csak olvasas):
     SELECT id, email, name, role, status, onboarded_at, created_at FROM app_user;
     SELECT count(*) FROM app_user;
   Varhato: pontosan 1 sor, role='OWNER'.

2. Ha megvan a sor es az email ismeros -> CSAK JELSZO-RESET kell. Ket ut:
   a) Az S3 beta-admin jelszo-reset folyamata (mezo-qw37.3) — ha van hozza belepesi ut.
   b) Kozvetlen SQL: uj bcrypt hash beirasa a password_hash-be. A hasht a
      PasswordEncoder-rel egyezo bcrypt-tel kell eloallitani (SecurityConfiguration).
   FONTOS: az AuthService.login trimmeli es lowercase-eli az emailt, tehat a
   bejelentkezesnel a normalizalt formaval probalkozz.

3. Ha tobb sor van, vagy az adat nem ahhoz a sorhoz kotodik, amelyikkel be tudsz lepni:
   akkor kell donteni ujrakotes (UPDATE created_by minden owned tablan) vagy torles kozott.
   A felhasznalo jelezte: az adat torlese NEM baj, nincs benne semmi extra.

4. Csak vegso esetben: teljes adattorles. Erre letezik scripts/purge-restart.sql — DE
   figyelem, azt az S4 (mezo-qw37.4) modositotta a pantry_catalog miatt; a hasznalata elott
   olvasd el a hozza tartozo runbookot.

BUKTATOK:
- Az OwnerSeedData idempotens es email szerint nez (existsByEmail), de csak demodata alatt fut.
- Ha uj fiokot hozol letre regisztracioval, az UJ id-t kap, es a regi adat NEM latszik majd
  rajta — a created_by nem valtozik magatol.
close_reason: Closed

title: FlagEvaluatorMissedWorkoutsIT.missed_workouts_only_counts_planned_days_from_the_schedule_creation_date_onward csak csütörtökön és szombaton zöld
description:
Weekday-dependent failure (not a rare flake) in
backend/src/test/java/io/mrkuhne/mezo/feature/companion/flags/FlagEvaluatorMissedWorkoutsIT.java:213

Assertion: `assertThat(payload).isPresent()` ->
`java.lang.AssertionError: Expecting Optional to contain a value but it was empty.`

CAUSE (deterministic, weekday-driven):
- The fixture backdates a Mon/Wed/Fri gym schedule (dow 0/2/4) to `today.minusDays(3)`.
- MissedWorkoutsRule scans [today-windowDays .. today-1] but clamps `from` to the earliest
  gym_schedule_slot.created_at date, so the effective window is exactly
  {today-3, today-2, today-1}.
- It raises only when longestRun >= min-consecutive-missed = 2, i.e. at least TWO of those
  three days are Mon/Wed/Fri.

Enumerating today's weekday (Mon..Sun) over the 3-day clamped window:
  Mon -> {Fri}        = 1 planned -> NO RAISE -> FAIL
  Tue -> {Mon}        = 1         -> FAIL
  Wed -> {Mon}        = 1         -> FAIL

title: deploy piros a mainen: az index chunk átlépte a workbox 2 MiB precache-limitet

comments.author: mrkuhne
comments.text:
Plan written: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-proactive-coaching-s6-rules-batch-b.md

Recon findings that change the shape of this slice:

1. The spec's metric names are stale. COMBINED_TRAINING_LOAD is really MetricKey.COMBINED_LOAD_MIN; LAST_MEAL_CLOCK is really MetricKey.LATE_MEAL_HOUR. Both exist.

2. TWO unbounded metric reads must be fixed FIRST (Task 1), not one. mezo-9gp3's WEIGHT_TREND_PCT_WK is confirmed (weightLogRepository.findAllOwned then Java-filter), and LATE_MEAL_HOUR has the IDENTICAL shape (mealRepository.findAllOwned then Java-filter) — not previously filed. Both are about to be called per-user-per-hour by FlagSweepJob. Note the weight fix must bound to [from-6, to], not [from, to]: the metric is a 7-day rolling slope, so narrowing to the requested window would silently change its values at every window's start.

3. acute_bad_day must NOT read a metric series. CHECKIN_BODY/CHECKIN_ENERGY are day-AVERAGED, and averaging is exactly what destroys "≥2 check-ins with body ≤3 or energy ≤3". Use CheckInRepository.findByCreatedByAndDateOrderBySlotTime and count raw rows.

4. load_fuel_mismatch's honesty gate cannot be computed from its own load series. COMBINED_LOAD_MIN is calendar-complete — an unlogged day is a real 0.0 — so "≥4 logged days" has to be counted from the kcal and sleep sides.

5. ignored_nudge is the most composed rule: push_log rows (no date-range finder exists — one must be added), MetricKey.BEDTIME_HOUR (which shifts sub-noon hours by +24 so post-midnight bedtimes sort on one line — compare in that shifted space), and SleepAnchorPort, which GHOSTS a config default when no sleep_goal row exists (so the rule must gate on the row through SleepGoalRepository directly, or it measures the user against an invented target).

6. all_healthy's suppression list needs a per-key decision. existsProblemRaiseSince hardcodes NOT IN ('all_healthy','logging_gap'). Applying the spec's own reasoning for excluding logging_gap (a data-availability gap, not a health problem): ignored_nudge joins the exclusion list (it is the app's nudging failing, not the user's health); the other five stay counted as problems.

7. AdvicePriority.ORDER already holds all six keys as string literals marked // S6 — this slice promotes them to the new FlagKey constants. AdviceFactRenderer's switch has a SILENT default (an unmapped key ships a card with an empty evidence block), and S4's reflection guard over that switch will be red until all six arms exist.

8. skip_sport_slot is NOT offered by any S6 rule (the spec assigns lighten to joint_overuse and the anchor shift to ignored_nudge, and nothing to the skip). Task 12 still closes mezo-cq06 because the backend already honours the skip while five FE surfaces do not — a live coherence seam either way.

Rules are implemented in SEVERITY order (acute_bad_day first), so if the slice is ever cut short the most urgent detection is the one that shipped.

comments.author: mrkuhne
comments.text:
S5 constraints discovered while shipping S4 (2026-09-04), all verified in code on main.

1. THE CARD SHAPE S5 EXTENDS. `advice` is now the single daily coaching card and
   AdviceCardService.deliver is its ONLY writer. The envelope
   (CompanionMessageEnvelope) carries, as TRAILING jsonb components: adviceKey (the severity key —
   flag key or setup-check key, ranked by AdvicePriority), interventionKey (the intervention-LIBRARY
   ENTRY key), setupKey, facts and suggestions. The spec §5 payload's `actions[]` and `applied` were
   deliberately NOT added — S5 adds them as further trailing components (safe: no
   @JsonIgnoreProperties, no FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES override, no jsonb path query; old rows
   deserialize new trailing fields to null. REMOVING one would not be safe).
2. THE CONTRACT LIKEWISE. FeedMessageResponse gained optional `facts` and `suggestions` only; the
   action buttons' wire shape is S5's to design, alongside the 3 mutation endpoints. api/openapi.yml
   and frontend/src/data/_client/api.gen.ts are GENERATED from api/feature/proactive/proactive.yml —
   regenerate (cd api/generate && npm run generate:api; cd frontend && pnpm generate:api).
3. WRITE PATH IS SERIALIZED PER USER. AdviceCardService.deliver takes a transaction-scoped
   pg_advisory_xact_lock (CompanionMessageRepository.lockForDelivery) before reading the incumbent,
   because two @Async raises could otherwise both see "no incumbent" and let the unique index decide
   the card. If S5's apply-endpoint writes `applied` back onto the card row, it must respect the same
   invariant the lock javadoc states: no writer may take a companion_message ROW lock before the
   advisory lock in the same transaction. Today's callers satisfy it only because everything they do
   before deliver is read-only.
4. IDEMPOTENCE HAS A SUBTLETY. Supersession soft-deletes the loser, and every cooldown/re-emit read
   goes through @SQLRestriction("is_deleted = false"), so a superseded card stops counting against
   its cooldown. An apply endpoint that targets a card id must therefore handle "that card was
   superseded since you saw it" — the row is still there, just not live.
5. SETUP CARDS STILL HAVE NO PUSH (mezo-5qek). A setup-sourced advice row carries a null
   interventionKey, so AnchorResolver's channel gate finds no library entry and yields no anchor.
   After S4 this is a CONFIG-shaped fix (give the setup checks a channel), not a code one.
6. TEST TRAP: any IT that reaches delivery now reaches the LLM path and needs
   @ActiveProfiles("companion-fake") at class level, or Spring wires the real chat model. Bit
   SetupCheckServiceIT, InterventionServiceIT, PlanFeasibilityIT and AdviceCardServiceIT in S4.

comments.author: mrkuhne
comments.text:
Plan written: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-proactive-coaching-s5-mutation-set.md

Three spec contradictions were escalated to the owner (2026-09-04) and decided; the spec text is superseded on these points:

1. "Lighten TOMORROW" is not expressible as the spec describes. Exercises hang off the weekday TEMPLATE row (workout_session, templateSessionId=null) and there is NO per-instance override anywhere in the repo, so writing the template lightens every future occurrence of that weekday. The only existing write path (TrainService.replaceDayExercises) also soft-deletes and re-inserts every exercise with NEW UUIDs, orphaning already-logged exercise_set rows. And the spec's "updateBlock recompute idiom" is a false analogy — that is RunningService.updateBlock triggering a goal-EAT recompute; there is no gym-side recompute at all.
   DECISION: a new workout_day_adjustment(created_by, date, set_delta) row applied at READ time. Template untouched, UUIDs stable, undo = row delete.

2. sport_slot_skip keyed on slot id would silently die. sport_schedule_slot rows are FULL-REPLACED on every schedule save, so slot ids churn; the skip would point at a soft-deleted row after the user's first schedule edit and do nothing, forever, with no error.
   DECISION: key on the slot's IDENTITY — (day_of_week, time, date). Moving a slot does not carry its skip along, which is correct: that is a different session.

3. "Today/briefing/feasibility respect it" is 8 read paths, not 3.
   DECISION: all date-specific ones + the FE (WorkoutWindowQueryService x2, AnchorResolver push, TrainTools, ContextSnapshotAssembler, PlanFeasibilityCalculator, weekAgenda.ts). EXCLUDED: WeeklyScheduledActivityService (week-aggregate goal-EAT) — one skipped day is a rounding error there and the goal-recompute path is the most sensitive in the app.

ASSUMPTION flagged in the plan, not escalated: PlanFeasibilityCalculator has no date at all (it reasons over the recurring weekly pattern), so a slot on weekday D is checked against the NEXT occurrence of D on or after evaluate()'s `today`.

SIZE: this slice is ~2x S4. The plan is split into Phase 1 (card action framework + sleep-anchor shift, independently shippable) and Phase 2 (the two train mutations); the phase boundary is a real seam if it wants to land as two PRs.

comments.author: mrkuhne
comments.text:
S4 planning constraints discovered while shipping S1-S3 (2026-09-03/04). All verified in code, none of it is guesswork:

1. SEVERITY GATE MUST SUBSUME SETUP CARDS, not just rank them. S3 shipped SetupCheckService gating on KIND_SETUP and InterventionService gating on KIND_INTERVENTION *independently* — so today a setup card AND an intervention card can both land on the same day. Spec §4 wants one card/day across all tiers (order: acute_bad_day > load_fuel_mismatch > rapid_weight_loss > joint_overuse > missed_workouts > sleep_debt > logging_gap > ignored_nudge > late_eating > setup cards > round-0 flags). S4 has to replace BOTH first-wins gates with one gate, not add a third.

2. ADDING A companion_message KIND NEEDS 5 MIRRORS (the 'advice' kind will need all of them):
   a) CompanionMessageEntity.KIND_* constant
   b) ck_companion_message_kind DB CHECK — NEW Liquibase changeset, drop+re-add (changesets are immutable); template: 202609040900_mezo-d58h.3_companion_message_setup_kind.sql
   c) FeedMessageResponse.kind enum in api/feature/proactive/proactive.yml
   d) FeedMessageKind union in frontend/src/data/types.ts
   e) FeedMessageKindSource (feature/companion/feedback/service) — a hand-duplicated literal mirror whose own javadoc says "keep both sides in step"; it was found missing 'people' AND 'setup' in S3's whole-branch review. THIS is where 'advice' will need a feedback rollup scope.
   api/openapi.yml and frontend/src/data/_client/api.gen.ts are GENERATED from (c) — regenerate (cd api/generate && npm run generate:api; cd frontend && pnpm generate:api), never hand-edit, or the contract-drift CI job fails.

3. missed_workouts -> MORNING COMPANION PROMPT is still owed. Spec §4 row 3 says the fact should reach "the morning companion prompt (no more blind cheering)". S2 deliberately deferred the prompt-assembly half to S4 and shipped a payload rich enough to feed it: FlagPayloadEnvelope.MissedWorkouts{windowDays, minConsecutiveMissed, longestMissedRun, missedDays[], plannedDays[]}. The prompt work lives in CompanionMessageJob/CompanionMessageGenerator's context block.

4. CompanionMessageEnvelope already carries interventionKey and setupKey (both nullable, one non-null per row). The advice card's richer payload {facts, prose, suggestions[], actions[], applied} should follow that same all-nullable-fields + static-factory-per-shape idiom. Adding a TRAILING component is jsonb-safe (verified: no @JsonIgnoreProperties, no FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES override, no jsonb path query, old rows deserialize the new field to null); REMOVING one would not be.

5. Existing LLM idiom to follow: pure-code gather -> ONE CompanionLlm call -> defensive parse -> bounds-checked (the model selects refs by index, never invents them); FakeCompanionLlm in ITs. Spec §5 requires template-prose fallback on LLM failure — the card is never dropped.

comments.author: mrkuhne
comments.text:
PROCESS NOTE after S1-S3 (2026-09-04) — the one bug class this epic keeps producing.

Every slice so far shipped at least one defect that was AN ENUMERATION NOBODY RE-DERIVES, and none was caught by tests:
- S1: COMBINED_LOAD_MIN is a calendar series (every day present, un-logged days a real 0.0). MemoryObservatoryService unions keySet() across all MetricKey.values() to compute L0 daysWithAnyData and skipped only WEEKEND — so a user with NO data reported the whole 60-day lookback. Caught by CI (CompanionMemoryOverviewApiIT), 2/3459 failures. Fixed by excluding it alongside WEEKEND; the other three values() consumers were audited and correctly left alone (per-metric display or a name check, not cross-metric presence counting).
- S2: adding a FlagKey turned out to need FIVE mirrored changes, not the three the plan listed — the @Pattern regexes on CompanionFlagLogEntity.flagKey (found mid-task, Bean Validation rejects the row before the DB CHECK) and on CompanionProperties.Intervention.flag (found in the whole-branch review; would have hard-failed S4 at Spring context startup).
- S3: FeedMessageKindSource hand-duplicates the companion_message kind constants and was missing both 'people' (stale from an earlier slice) and 'setup'.

For S4-S6 recon: after extending ANY enum-like set, grep for every place that enumerates it — @Pattern regexes, switch defaults, DB CHECKs, values() loops, contract enums, FE type unions, hand-copied constant mirrors. bd memory key: adding-a-flagkey-needs-five-mirrored-changes.

Other durable traps confirmed in code this epic:
- SleepGoalService and SleepAnchorResolver ghost a config default when no sleep_goal row exists, so the missing-row condition is INVISIBLE through every normal read path; read SleepGoalRepository directly.
- A Maven -Dtest glob that matches no file runs nothing and still exits 0 (cost two slices a vacuous "green" run on ProactiveFeed*IT, real class ProactiveApiFeedIT).
- MealPopulator's default loggedAt is a hardcoded 2026-06-24T11:30Z, so any "fresh meal" fixture must use the explicit-instant overload or it silently reads as stale.
- main moves under long branches: it replaced appUserRepository.findAll() with UserFanOut.forEachActiveUser in every @Scheduled job mid-S3. Check cron conventions at merge time.

comments.author: mrkuhne
comments.text:
PROCESS NOTE after S4 (2026-09-04) — the enumeration bug class held, but a NEW class appeared.

The enumeration discipline finally worked: `advice` went into all five mirrors in one task, the two
silent consumers (AnchorResolver's push anchor, FeedMessageKindService's effectiveness rollup —
both filtered on KIND_INTERVENTION and would have gone quietly dead) were found by a deliberate
grep audit before the flip, and the whole-branch review swept for a sixth site and found none.
AdvicePriority also ships a reflection test asserting every live FlagKey has a rank, and S4's fix
wave added the twin for AdviceFactRenderer's switch. Two structural guards now fail loudly instead
of shipping an empty card.

The NEW class S4 produced: CHANGING A GATE'S SEMANTICS BREAKS RACES THAT USED TO BE BENIGN.
InterventionService always had a check-then-insert race (two @Async FlagRaisedEvent listeners from
ONE evaluation), and it was harmless while all cards were equal — first-wins was the intended
semantics and the partial unique index was a legitimate arbiter. The moment severity decided the
card, that same race meant COMMIT ORDER, not AdvicePriority, picked what the user saw — silently,
with the loser's DataIntegrityViolationException swallowed at info by the listener's catch as
"expected". Caught only by the final gate, via a test that had been re-pointed one task earlier.
Fixed with a per-user pg_advisory_xact_lock in AdviceCardService.deliver + a real-threads IT; the
listener's catch is now a loud warn framed as "the lock regressed".
Generalized lesson for S5/S6: when a slice changes what a gate MEANS, re-audit every concurrency
path and every swallowed exception that the old meaning made acceptable.

Second lesson, cheaper: ADDING CONFIG CHANGES BEHAVIOUR IN TESTS NOBODY EDITED. S4 finally gave
logging_gap and missed_workouts intervention-library entries (S2 shipped both flags with an EMPTY
library — they raised and delivered nothing for two slices). That instantly turned an unrelated
IT red, because its fixture incidentally raises logging_gap, which outranks the sustained_stress
the test asserted. Adding a library entry is a behaviour change, not data.

Third: a library entry must not assert anything the SELECTION cannot verify. The first
logging_gap_sleep_suspicion copy claimed the logged nights are short — true only when the raise
carried the suspicion sub-signal, while entry selection reads only flag + effectiveness. With the
sibling entry in cooldown the card asserted shorter sleep above an evidence list with no sleep
line at all. Caught in the whole-branch review; reworded to assert only the unlogged nights.

comments.author: mrkuhne
comments.text:
Round 1 complete: all six slices shipped and merged to main.

S1–S2 the flag spine + first detections; S3 setup checks (missing sleep goal, plan feasibility); S4 the advice card as the single daily coaching surface with a severity gate and one cheap-tier LLM call guarded against invented numbers; S5 the narrow mutation set (shift_sleep_anchor, skip_sport_slot, lighten_tomorrow) as reversible read-time overlays; S6 the last six detections plus the two unbounded metric reads (mezo-9gp3) and the FE sport-skip seam (mezo-cq06).

Thirteen live flags, each with an honesty gate that stays silent rather than guessing when its precondition is unreadable. The epic's recurring trap — a flag key needing five mirrors, three of which fail only at runtime — is now structurally closed: three enumeration sites police themselves by reflection and the fact renderer throws on an unmapped live key.

Round 2 continues as mezo-d58h.7, detached to stand on its own.

comments.author: mrkuhne
comments.text:
Megoldás: NEM tiltás, hanem sorrend-független feloldás + páronkénti lint (PR #394, merge fda82eddf).

Az átfedés nem tiltható: a routerben a T3 detail-route-ok mellett ott ülnek a literál testvéreik — /me/people/:id vs /me/people/heti|kor|jeloltek, /me/goals/:id vs /me/goals/new|weight, /fuel/recipes/:id vs /fuel/recipes/muhely|new, /train/mesocycles/:id vs /train/mesocycles/compare|new. Az S3/S4 mindet felveszi.

Ezért a második opció (explicit sorrend-szerződés) ment be, a legerősebb formájában:
- resolveKalauz(entries, pathname) — a router SAJÁT matchRoutes-rangsora dönt, nem a tömbsorrend; a literál veri a paraméterest, ugyanúgy, ahogy a router választotta az oldalt. findKalauz erre delegál. A registry/index.ts 'a sorrend lényegtelen' megjegyzése ezzel IGAZ lett.
- route-lint: nincs két azonos route-minta.
- sorrend-lint: minden átfedő párra tanú-útvonalat épít (literál szegmensek fixek, a két paraméteres pozíció helyőrzőt kap), és megköveteli, hogy a registry megfordítása ugyanazt a kalauzt oldja fel. Ez a matchRoutes HOLTVERSENYEIT fogja meg (/me/:a/heti vs /me/people/:b — mindkettő 10+3+10, a rangsor nem dönt), ahol ma is a tömbsorrend nyerne. Hibaüzenet: 'a (route) ⇄ b (route) — <tanú pathname>'.
- A lint elkapó-képességét saját teszt bizonyítja szintetikus holtversenyes páron; ellenőrizve egy ideiglenes duplikált /nap bejegyzéssel is.

FONTOS az S3-nak: a naiv 'minden entry saját helyőrzős útvonalát próbáld' detektor NEM kapja el a holtversenyt — RED-ben kibukott, ezért lett páronkénti tanú-építés.

A mai registryben nincs átfedés (mind az öt hub-kalauz egyszegmensű literál) — nincs S2a-javítanivaló.

Mellékesen: a welcome 'first-match' indoklása (welcome.ts, welcome.test.ts, docs/features/tutorial.md §2) elavult lett, javítva; §7 megkapta a szerződést; docs/CODEMAP.md regenerálva (az S2b óta állt: lint.ts, welcome.ts, KalauzWelcome.tsx).

description: frontend/src/features/train/pages/ActiveWorkoutPage.test.tsx > 'real mode: a hard reload on /train/session resumes instead of redirecting while queries load' consistently times out at the 5000 ms default on ubuntu-latest, while passing locally. Verified NOT caused by any feature branch: main's own ci run 33697964585 (head 321871acb, 2026-09-03T00:05Z) fails on exactly this test with 577/578 files passing, and PR #380's run 33701903642 fails identically with 582/583. Consequence: NO pull request can reach a green ci run until this is fixed, so it blocks the whole self-PR gate. Likely fix: give this one test an explicit longer timeout (vitest's third test() argument) or make its wait deterministic instead of racing the query-loading window; check whether the test's waitFor chain can assert on a settled state instead. Owner note: found while landing mezo-iizd.1, which does not touch train.

comments.author: mrkuhne
comments.text:
S2a kész (PR #378, CI zöld, merge-re vár). Él: fogalmak.ts (5 kulcs: napszak/mezociklus/makro/minta/szint, kulcs szerint hivatkozva, a registryben feloldva), öt T1 hub-kalauz (nap/train/fuel/mezo/me), négy anchor (nap-hero ×4, train-hero ×6, mezo-chat, me-idhero), seedAllKalauzSeen() teszt-helper, szótár- + art- + wildcard-tudatos route-lintek.

MOTOR-VÁLTOZÁS, amit az S2b örököl: a TutorialProvider route-effektje mostantól NEM ütemez auto-opent, amíg bármi nyitva van (openIdRef !== null), és a KalauzSheet key={openId}-t kapott. Ez egy reduced-motion race javítása volt (chip navigál -> a 0 ms auto-open a még kilépő sheetbe nyílt -> a késve érkező onClose a CÉL kalauzra írt completedAt-ot). Mellékhatás, szándékos: chip soha nem láncol tovább a cél kalauzába. A guard egyben az S2b welcome elnyomó-varrata — a welcome-nak nem kell újat építenie.

S2b ELŐTT eldöntendő (spec §6, researcher recon): az NN/G 70 fős kontrollált mérése szerint a statikus intro-kártyapakli nézői nem lettek sikeresebbek (91% vs 94%), viszont NEHEZEBBNEK élték meg a feladatokat (4,92 vs 5,49). A mérés statikus paklikat vizsgált standard UI-mintákkal; a koppintható, valós UI-t begyakoroltató lépések evidencia-hézagban vannak. Az NN/G taxonómia kifejezetten ellenzi a welcome -> azonnal auto-felugró /nap kalauz láncot. Tehát: a hat lépés megtartása NEM adott, a brainstormnak ezzel kell kezdenie.

S2b TECHNIKAI CSAPDA: a seedAllKalauzSeen() a KALAUZ_REGISTRY-ből generál, tehát a T0 welcome-ot nem fedi. Ha a welcome nem registry-bejegyzés, minden konvertált shell-teszt (navigation, notificationRoutes, hubHeaders, AppHeader, train.nav, train.emptyStates, insights.nav, anchors) welcome-képernyőt fog enni — a helpert ugyanabban a commitban bővíteni kell.

S3 ELŐTT: az index.ts 'a sorrend lényegtelen' megjegyzése hamissá válik, amint egy T2 kalauz paraméteres route-ot használ (pl. /mezo/patterns/:id a /mezo/patterns mellett) — findKalauz az ELSŐ találatot adja. Átfedés-lint kell a ~32 kalauzos szelet előtt, nem utána.

comments.text:
S2b KÉSZ (mezo-gb1s.4 + mezo-gb1s.2 lezárva). PR #393, CI mind az öt jobon zöld, merge 8c70c7328 (--no-ff), branch törölve.

ÉL: registry/welcome.ts (négy lépés: napszak · tabbar · log · sugo, a KALAUZ_REGISTRY-n KÍVÜL, WELCOME_VERSION=1, seen-kulcs 'welcome' ugyanabban a tutorial_progress mapben — nincs contract-változás); registry/lint.ts (a hang-lint EGY helyen, a welcome szövegei is átmennek rajta); versionOf(id) (enélkül isUnseen('welcome') mindig false lenne); shared/ui/kalauz/KalauzWelcome.tsx (domain-mentes full-screen lapozó, portál a .phone-screen-be, z-index 60, APG fókusz-szerződés, a Vissza gomb elérhető neve pontosan 'Vissza'); a Provider trigger + /nap auto-open elnyomás; honest resetAll(); 'Kalauzok újranézése' sor a Beállításokban.

MOTOR-VÁLTOZÁSOK, amit az S3 örököl:
1. A route-effekt guardja most: if (openIdRef.current !== null || shouldWelcomeRef.current) return. A shouldWelcome route-hoz kötött (pathname === '/nap'), tehát MÁS oldal kalauzát nem nyomja el — ezt a whole-branch review külön végigkövette.
2. A route-effekt force-dismiss ága mostantól a nyitott KalauzWelcome-ot is zárja (dismissedAtStep: 0), nem csak a KalauzSheet-et.
3. A welcome open-effektje a mapjét mergeProgress(serverProgress, progressRef.current)-ből számolja, NEM a refből — a puszta ref a saját effekt-flush-án belül elavult, és új eszközön egy csak-welcome map írta felül a szerver-merge-elt mapet (lokálisan és PUT-tal is).
4. A welcome open-effektje gate-el arra, hogy nyitva van-e már valami (openId VALÓDI dep, nem csak ref) — a .welcome z-60, a sheetek 200, tehát őrizet nélkül a sheet MÖGÖTT nyílt volna meg, seenAt-et írva magára.
5. A reset mutáció optimista setQueryData(KEY, {})-t ír a DELETE ELŐTT, hibára visszagörget — enélkül a régi map a cache-ben maradt a DELETE teljes körideje alatt.
6. buildAllSeenProgress() explicit 'welcome' sort kapott (a registry-ciklus nem fedi).

FOLYTATÁS: mezo-gvbl (findKalauz átfedés-lint, P1) az S3 ELŐFELTÉTELE — az S3a-d (mezo-gb1s.5-.8) blocks-függősége már be van kötve. Utána S4 (mezo-gb1s.9), opcionálisan S5 (mezo-gb1s.10). Az S4 megkisebbedett: a Beállítások sor + DELETE az S2b-ben landolt.

comments.author: mrkuhne
comments.text:
mezo-gvbl KÉSZ (PR #394, merge fda82eddf, CI mind az öt jobon zöld) — az S3 előfeltétele leesett, mind a négy S3 szelet (.5-.8) READY.

AMIT AZ S3 ÖRÖKÖL A gvbl-BŐL — ez a registry-tartalom írásának új szabálya:

1. resolveKalauz(entries, pathname) (registry/index.ts) — a findKalauz MÁR NEM first-match. A router SAJÁT matchRoutes-rangsora dönt, tehát a literál route veri a paraméterest (/me/people/heti nyer a /me/people/:id ellen), ugyanúgy, ahogy a router választotta ki az oldalt. A KALAUZ_REGISTRY tömbsorrendje TÉNYLEG irreleváns — az index.ts:11 megjegyzése immár igaz, nem csak javítva.

2. Az ÁTFEDÉS ENGEDÉLYEZETT és elkerülhetetlen. A routerben a T3 detail-route-ok mellett ott ülnek a literál testvéreik: /me/people/:id vs /me/people/heti|kor|jeloltek|emlitesek, /me/goals/:id vs /me/goals/new|weight, /fuel/recipes/:id vs /fuel/recipes/muhely|new, /train/mesocycles/:id vs /train/mesocycles/compare|new|templates/:id, /train/custom/:id vs /train/custom/new. Az S3/S4 mindet fel fogja venni — nem kell kerülgetni őket.

3. AMI TILOS, két lint (registry.test.ts):
   a) route-lint: két bejegyzésnek nem lehet AZONOS route-mintája.
   b) sorrend-lint: átfedő pár nem lehet RANG-HOLTVERSENYES. Holtverseny = ahol a matchRoutes pontszáma egyenlő (statikus szegmens 10, paraméteres 3), tehát a tömbsorrend döntene némán — pl. /me/:a/heti vs /me/people/:b, mindkettő 10+3+10. Hibaüzenet: 'a (route) ⇄ b (route) — <tanú pathname>'. Javítás: az egyik mintát specifikusabbá tenni.
   A gyakorlatban a b) csak akkor csap le, ha valaki NEM-ELSŐ szegmensben tesz paramétert egy literál mellé. A T2/T3 route-ok a routerből másolva ilyet nem hoznak.

4. FONTOS a lint továbbfejlesztéséhez: a naiv 'minden entry saját helyőrzős útvonalát próbáld' detektor NEM kapja el a holtversenyt (RED-ben kibukott — /me/x1/heti és /me/people/x1 egyike sem matcheli a másikat). Ezért PÁRONKÉNTI tanú-építés van: a literál szegmensek fixek, a két paraméteres pozíció kap helyőrzőt. Ne 'egyszerűsítsd vissza'.

5. A mai registryben NINCS átfedés (mind az öt hub-kalauz egyszegmensű literál) — nem volt S2a-javítanivaló.

6. A welcome 'first-match' indoklása elavult lett (welcome.ts, welcome.test.ts, docs/features/tutorial.md §2): most azonos-minta-ütközés, amit a route-lint elutasít. A feature-doc §7 megkapta a teljes szerződést a hibaüzenet-formátummal.

7. Az S3 szeletek DEPENDS ON éle fordítva volt bekötve (gvbl depends on .5-.8 helyett gvbl blocks .5-.8) — megfordítva. Ha máshol is így nézne ki egy 'előfeltétel', érdemes bd dep tree-vel ellenőrizni.

Az S2b-ből örökölt hat motor-változás (route-guard, force-dismiss, welcome open-effekt merge-alapú mapje és 'már nyitva' gate-je, optimista reset-cache, buildAllSeenProgress() explicit welcome-sora) VÁLTOZATLANUL érvényes — lásd az ezt megelőző kommentet.

S3a KÉSZ (mezo-gb1s.5 lezárva). PR #401, CI mind az öt jobon zöld, merge 8cf90e22e (--no-ff), branch törölve.

ÉL: 14 T2 kalauz (Nap: uzenetek/rutin/kuldetesek/checkin/eletjel · Edzés: mai/week/sport/futas/exercises/medals/mesocycles/session/review), registry/nap.ts + train.ts T2 blokkjai; fogalmak.ts +eletjel +rir (a szint és a mezociklus újrahasznosítva); 12 data-kalauz-anchor + DayStrip kalauzAnchor prop; D11 mini ? a /train/session prep breadcrumbjában (chrome-mentes oldal, a fejléc-? ott nem létezik). A /train/review/:workoutId a registry ELSŐ paraméteres route-ja — a gvbl-lint zölden viszi.

SPEC §13.1 ELDŐLT: a napszak-váltó minden route-on MARAD (navigációs affordance a mezo-atry egy-fejléc óta; off-now pötty onNap-scoped; D10 a ?-t balra horgonyozta). Feature-doc §9 + a spec §13.1 frissítve.

AMIT AZ S3b-d ÖRÖKÖL:
1. A 'kalauz nélküli route' teszt-fixture-ök elköltöztek: TutorialProvider.test + AppHeader.test → /me/sleep/night (D11 szerint TARTÓSAN kalauz-mentes); hubHeaders.test → /me/week/napok (S4-ig jó, kommentben jelezve). Új T2 bejegyzésnél ezekhez nem szabad nyúlni.

4. ActiveWorkoutPage.test harness: TutorialProvider + seedAllKalauzSeen beforeEach — a page useTutorial()-t hív; ha új teszt közvetlenül rendereli, provider nélkül dob.
5. Darwin goldenek TELJESEN regenerálva (a main-oldali elmaradással együtt) — a linux goldeneket a workflow frissítette; a workflow-bot pushja NEM triggerel CI-t, üres trigger-committal kellett rásegíteni (mezo-iizd.5 mintája).

Menet közben talált, felírt hibák: mezo-hxyy (P1 — a main DEPLOY-ja piros: az index chunk átlépte a workbox 2 MiB precache-limitet; a ci.yml nem buildel, ezért a PR-kapu nem fogja); + a FuelSettingsSheet cold-open teszt dietPending-race-e (mezo-ktg8 mellékhatás) ebben a PR-ban lett waitFor-ral hardenelve.

fuel-kamra, fuel-gyogyszer, fuel-naplo) a registry/fuel.ts-ben; fogalmak.ts +ablak

DÖNTÉS a szelet nyitott mikro-kérdésére: a spec §10 „Gyors logolás sheet" (`quickinput`)
tétele S4-RE HALASZTVA (b opció). Nem route, a motor egyetlen auto-open triggere a
route-effekt — komponens-esemény seam kell hozzá (az `open(id)` már ma is tetszőleges
id-t fogad, csak az auto-open triggerhez nincs kapaszkodó). Motor-munka, nem tartalom,
ezért az S4 motor-simításaival megy. A spec §10 sora és a feature-doc §9 is rögzíti.

AMIT AZ S3c/S3d ÖRÖKÖL:

1. ÚJ SEAM: PageHero (shared/ui/mozaik) kapott opcionális `kalauzAnchor` propot — a
   Mozaik-aloldalakon a hős gyakran az EGYETLEN feltétel nélkül renderelő elem, tehát

   auto-open sheetje a PLAYWRIGHT layout-tesztek kattintását is elnyeli. A
   tests/visual/layout.spec.ts „Kamra-picker" tesztje 30 s-en timeoutolt a /fuel/log
   kalauztól. Javítás: a seed közös modulba került — tests/visual/kalauzSeed.ts

3. Horgony-mérleg: 6 anchor (log-napvalto a nap-léptetőn, log-forrasok a MealComposer

   horgony NÉLKÜL: /fuel/plan (minden beszélő kártyája adat-feltételes) és
   /fuel/gyogyszer (két diszjunkt arc, a gyakorlatban tartósan üres — ADR 0027).
4. A registry.test.ts első tesztje átírva: a /fuel/log-nak MOST van kalauza; az új
   kalauz-mentes tanú a /fuel/slots (csak a FuelSettingsSheet-ből érhető el, a §10

title: ActiveWorkoutPage.test.tsx 5s timeout-flake terhelés alatt
description: Két-öt teszt (pl. 'reaching the summary screen shows no rest bar', 'hard reload on /train/session resumes') 5000ms timeouttal bukik lokálisan párhuzamos terhelés alatt, futásonként változó halmazban; izolált futásban is elő tud jönni (75s fájl-futásidő). Nem köthető a mezo-ms9a branchhez (train-fájl nem változott). Javaslat: testTimeout emelés a fájlra vagy a lassú userEvent-szekvenciák gyorsítása.
notes: 2026-09-03 (mezo-iizd.1 landing): this is NOT a load-dependent flake any more — it fails DETERMINISTICALLY on ubuntu-latest and survives a re-run, while passing locally in both modes. Decisive evidence that no feature branch causes it: main's own ci run 33697964585 (head 321871acb, 2026-09-03T00:05Z) fails on exactly this test with 577/578 files green, and PR #380's run 33701903642 fails identically with 582/583. Consequence: NO pull request can reach a green ci run, so this blocks the entire self-PR gate — raised to P1 for that reason. Likely fix: give this one test an explicit longer timeout (vitest's third test() argument) or make its wait deterministic instead of racing the query-loading window. See also mezo-d20.18 (same test, earlier isolated-passes observation).
close_reason: Already fixed on main by 7e3916911 (mezo-3zue.4, PR #381): the test got an explicit 20_000 ms ceiling. Root cause confirmed independently here: the test body does 'await import(@/app/router)', which transforms+evaluates the whole 103-page eager route graph INSIDE the 5000 ms test budget — measured 1579 ms of the 1.75 s test time locally on a 128 GB machine, so a contended 2-core ubuntu-latest runner blows the 5 s ceiling deterministically. Not a race; real module-load work. PR #381 reaching green CI confirms the gate is unblocked.

title: QueryProvider swallows failed owner-token bootstrap — app renders permanently unauthenticated
description: frontend/src/app/providers/QueryProvider.tsx:29-34: if bootstrapOwnerToken() rejects (backend down/restarting), the catch only console.errors and still calls setReady(true). The app then runs with token=null for the WHOLE session: every write 401s, and because a 401 body is not a SystemMessageList, apiFetch (frontend/src/data/_client/api.ts:34) synthesizes an INTERNAL_ERROR message with no exceptionTraceId, so the user only sees the generic 'Mentés sikertelen — próbáld újra' toast with no trace id and no hint that they are unauthenticated. Only a full reload recovers. Surfaced right after the mezo-rcsy purge (backend was scaled to 0 during it). Fix direction: retry the bootstrap (backoff) and/or surface an explicit 'nincs kapcsolat / jelentkezz be újra' state instead of rendering an unauthenticated app; consider re-bootstrapping on the first 401 from a write.
close_reason: Merged to main as d43b493bd. The bootstrap now retries on a 0.5s/1.5s/4s backoff; persistent failure renders the explicit 'Nem érem el a szervert' screen with Újra — an unauthenticated app never renders silently again. 4 provider tests. Closes mezo-aus's banner half too. Re-bootstrap-on-first-401 deliberately out of scope.

title: Advisor false pozitívok kiszűrése — TurnVerdictCheck unmarkedClaim pontossága
description:
CÉL: megállapítani, a companion advisor retry-jai közül melyik volt jogos és melyik false pozitív, és a prompt/kontextus melyik hiánya okozza őket.

KIINDULÁS (mezo-prb9 designja közben gyűjtve, élő llm_log_history, 2026-08-02..08-23):
17 streamelt kör / 6 violation-ös verdict / 4 retry (~24%). Mind a 6 violation unmarkedClaim volt (egynél redundantQuestion is).

KÉT GYANÚS FALSE-POZITÍV OSZTÁLY a 6 indoklásból:

(1) A BÍRÓ NEM LÁTJA A TOOL-KIMENETET. A TurnVerdictCheck javadocja ezt v1 korlátként rögzíti ('Tool results are not captured in v1'), és a bíró a 2026-08-23 08:43-as körben szó szerint ki is mondja: '...sem az eszközhívásból (mivel annak kimenete nincs megadva)...'. Vagyis MINDEN tool-ból származó konkrét szám (pl. a 85,536 kg kezdősúly) strukturálisan gyanús a bírónak, akkor is, ha tökéletesen megalapozott. Ez nem hangolási kérdés, hanem hiányzó bemenet.

(2) ÉRTÉKELÉST TÉNYÁLLÍTÁSNAK MINŐSÍT. A 2026-08-18 09:35 és a 2026-08-23 08:43 körben a bíró azért bukatta a választ, mert az a heti 0,347 / 0,366 kg ütemet 'pont a tervezett ütem' / 'megfelelő' minősítéssel illette a 0,8 kg/hét célhoz képest. Ez kvalitatív értékelés, nem kitalált szám — a promptban lévő 'A kontextusban szereplő adatokból számolt/becsült érték alátámasztottnak számít' kitétel elvileg fedné, a gyakorlatban nem fedi.

MÓDSZER: az llm_log_history minden szükséges nyersanyagot tárol — a stream response_text-je az attempt-1, a verdict_check response_text-je a JSON ítélet, a retry response_text-je az attempt-2. Végig kell nézni mind a 6 esetet (és a további gyűlőket) attempt-1/ítélet/attempt-2 hármasával, jogos/false pozitív címkével, és eldönteni, hogy a javítás rontott vagy javított-e a válaszon.

VÁRHATÓ KIMENET: vagy a tool-kimenetek bevezetése a bíró payloadjába (az (1)-re), vagy promptélesítés az értékelés/tényállítás határra (a (2)-re), vagy mindkettő — külön issue-kban. Ez az issue az AUDIT, nem a fix.

Kapcsolódó: mezo-prb9 (UI oldal), ADR 0028 (jelölt spekuláció szemantikája).

title: Fuel push bodies poisoned with '(törölt Kamra-item)' — snapshot writer races pantry query
description: The 'Stack · reggeli slot' (and every fuel_slot) push shows '(törölt Kamra-item)' for every item. Root cause: useScheduleSnapshotWriter (notificationScheduleWriter.ts) gates only on useSleepGoal().isPending; usePantry returns stash: [] while unresolved, so when the sleep-goal + protocol queries resolve before the (heaviest) pantry query, projectStackDay falls back to '(törölt Kamra-item)' for every occurrence and the poisoned bodies are PUT to /api/notification/schedule, which AnchorResolver pushes verbatim. Once poisoned it persists: opens where protocol is also unresolved only replace the checkin category. Fix: gate the snapshot on the pantry AND protocol queries having resolved too.
close_reason: Gate added: useScheduleSnapshotWriter now waits for useStack/useProtocol to settle successfully (pending/error flags) before snapshotting; poisoned rows self-heal on next app open after deploy.

title: LLM audit log retention/pruning — a tábla korlátlanul nő, teljes prompt/válasz szöveggel
description: WHY: az ADR 0014 (mezo-2zyu) 'Consequences' szakasza ezt nevezi meg az ELSŐ follow-upként: 'The table only grows. Nothing prunes it yet, and prompts/responses are stored.' A mezo-uakh óta böngészhető felület is van rá (/me/ai-usage), ami növeli a tétet: a sorok most már nem csak nőnek, hanem meg is nyithatók. Egy sor max 3x64000 karakternyi payloadot tárolhat (mezo.llm-log.max-payload-chars), és a prod kulcson ~100 hivas/nap ment. WHAT: retention-politika + pruning. Nyitott döntések, amiket a specnek el kell dontenie: (1) megtartási ablak — fix napszam vagy soronkent eltero (pl. a payload elobb tunik el, mint a koltseg-metaadat)? (2) a payload-oszlopok NULL-ozasa vs. a teljes sor DELETE-je — az elobbi megtartja a koltseg-tortenetet orokre, ami a feature eredeti celja volt (cost attribution), az utobbi egyszerubb; (3) hol fut — @Scheduled cron a techcore.cron mintajara (kapcsolo: mezo.techcore.cron.*), vagy DB-oldali job; (4) a tabla INSERT-only es SZANDEKOSAN nincs rajta is_deleted (az ADR 0014 allo kivetele a soft-delete hazszabaly alol), tehat a pruning HARD DELETE — ezt a dontest a specnek ujra ki kell mondania. FIGYELEM: a created_by nullable ON DELETE SET NULL, tehat a felhasznalo torlese nem viszi el a koltseg-tortenetet; a pruning ne rontsa el ezt a tulajdonsagot. Kapcsolodo: ADR 0014 docs/decisions/0014-llm-call-audit-log.md, tabla docs/features/companion.md '#Backend tables (LLM audit log)'.
close_reason: Closed

A debug-nyom (mit küldtünk / mit kaptunk) és a feature/modell szintű költség-attribúció ma is psql-t igényel. WHAT: teljes oldal /me/ai-usage (belépő: a Profil AiUsageCard koppintható lesz) — felül Ma/Hét/Hónap szegmens, korall hero (hívásszám + becsült költség + siker/hiba/megszakadt + árazatlan darab), feature-sávlista költség szerint (koppintás = szűrő), modell-bontás, szűrőchipek (státusz, call kind), majd cursor-lapozott hívás-lista. Sorra koppintva /me/ai-usage/:id részletoldal: meta-rács, token-sáv (prompt/válasz/gondolkodás/cache), befagyasztott ártábla-doboz a nettó-prompt számítással, és a három payload-blokk (system prompt / user üzenet / válasz) másolás gombbal. Contract-first: 3 új endpoint a llm-usage fragmentben (breakdown, calls, calls/{id}); dual-mode FE hookok. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-14-llm-audit-log-page-design.md. Követi: mezo-2zyu, mezo-h3gb.
close_reason: AI-napló oldal kész és élesítve. Backend: 3 read-endpoint a feature/llmlog csomagban (breakdown feature+modell rollupokkal, calls szerveroldali szűrőkkel és növekvő ablakkal, calls/{id} a verbatim payloaddal és a befagyasztott ártáblával). Frontend: /me/ai-usage + /me/ai-usage/:id teljes oldalak a me csoport testvéreiként, belépő a Profil AiUsageCard. Query-paraméterek pattern-validált stringek, nem enumok (mezo-x0nb miatt). ADR 0014 invariánsai végig tartanak: nincs created_by szűrés, a null költség sosem nulla. CI zöld, merge 7c3d92b9.

title: Medal collection: live per-set PR + progression-target medals (derived) + Train medal cabinet
description: Today nothing compares a logged set against either the progression target or the user's records. title: Chat answers before tool results are visible: no live tool SSE events + pre-tool narration
description:
The streamed turn makes the companion look like it answers before its tools run.

Three contributing causes:
1. The model narrates BEFORE calling a tool ('Nezzuk meg...', 'Most megprobalom megnezni...'). That preamble streams first and is persisted as part of the answer. ChatService.SYSTEM_PROMPT (service/ChatService.java:46-69) has no rule against pre-tool narration.
2. Tool chips and refs are back-filled at the very end. The wire carries exactly three events - delta/done/error (service/ChatStreamService.java:42-44) - and the FE's streaming bubble passes only {role, ts, text} (frontend ChatPage.tsx:73), so chips (ChatMessage.tsx:47) can only come from the terminal done payload. The whole tool phase renders as undifferentiated ThinkingDots.
3. At done the FE discards the streamed draft and renders the authoritative row (chatHooks.ts:97,102-104), which CompanionAdvisorChain.review (advisor/CompanionAdvisorChain.java:48-71) may have entirely rewritten in a non-streamed corrective round - so the text visibly swaps.

Verified NOT the cause: Spring AI's streaming tool loop is correct - GoogleGenAiChatModel.internalStream recurses with the tool result and streams the continuation.
acceptance_criteria: New 'tool' SSE event on the companion stream contract (api/feature/companion), emitted from the RecordingToolCallback choke point as each tool actually executes, with the same pre-baked 'name(args)' label as CompanionMapper; FE renders live tool chips during the stream; SYSTEM_PROMPT forbids pre-tool narration (call the tool first, answer from the result); backend + FE tests in both modes; docs/features/companion.md streaming section updated
close_reason: live 'tool' SSE event from the RecordingToolCallback/ToolCallAudit choke point + anti-preamble system prompt rule + FE live chips on the in-flight draft bubble; 5 tasks, all reviewed, whole-branch review clean

title: get_recipes cannot find a recipe by its name or ingredients
description:
FuelTools.matchesRecipeFilter (tools/FuelTools.java:372-386) matches only slot/category/tag/starred/fitsFor and deliberately NOT the recipe name. The comment cites 'spec R1', but that section does not exist anywhere in docs/ (nor in git history) - the real 'Recipe R1' in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-26-companion-tool-context-expansion.md:50 is the generic hub-tool boilerplate pattern, unrelated to filtering. So the exclusion is undocumented and unjustified.

Consequences:
- 'a smoothie collagen a receptek kozul' -> 'Receptek - "smoothie collagen": nincs adat' even when that recipe exists (real chat, 2026-07-29).
- ingredients[].name is in the same RecipeResponse the tool already holds, so 'mit fozzek csirkevel' / 'van valami turos' can never match either. role is unused too.
- Even a correct literal name cannot work reliably: a two-word needle is matched as ONE substring, so 'smoothie collagen' misses a recipe named 'Collagen Smoothie'.

Incidental defect in the same method: the starred branch (:380-382) matches bidirectionally (k.contains(needle) || needle.contains(k)), so any short needle that is a substring of 'csillagos'/'kedvenc'/'starred' (e.g. 'a', 'cs', 'red') matches EVERY starred recipe.

The filter-miss branch (:320) has zero test coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Token-based, accent-folded (NFD) scored matching over name + ingredient names + tags + category + slot + role + fitsFor; multi-word needles match in any order; best match wins the detail render; starred keyword match is exact-token (no bidirectional substring); @Tool/@ToolParam descriptions state what is actually matched (companion_tool_conventions.md); ITs cover name match, ingredient match, multi-word any-order match, the starred regression and the miss branch; docs/features/companion.md tool catalog updated
close_reason: scored accent-folded token match over name/ingredients/tags/category/slot/role/fitsFor; all-token hits win; best scorer renders detail; starred whole-token only; 5 ITs, 4 verified red-then-green

title: Companion is blind to scheduled sport on a given date
description:
get_training_plan renders only gym + running for today/tomorrow/week/date: TrainTools.dayContentLine (tools/TrainTools.java:276-295) never consults sport_schedule_slot, and SportService is not even injected (TrainTools.java:54-69). A volleyball evening renders 'gym: pihenonap', and the NO_DATA guard (:250, :263) can claim 'nincs adat' for a day that has a scheduled sport slot.

ContextSnapshotAssembler is asymmetric for the same reason: tomorrowLine (:283-311) adds sport + run, todayLine (:259-274) is gym-only. So 'Ma' under-reports and the model has to derive today's sport from the trailing raw weekly 'sport-rend' pattern (:230-234) - exactly the hallucination path the dated resolution was meant to remove.

Repro (real chat, 2026-07-29): 'mai napomrol mit latsz?' listed only the Full Body gym day; only when pushed with 'sport?' did the model derive '18:00, 120 perc' from the weekly pattern.
acceptance_criteria: get_training_plan scope=today|tomorrow|week|date renders the date's sport schedule slots (sport, time, kind, duration); a sport-only day is never 'nincs adat' and never bare 'pihenonap'; ContextSnapshotAssembler.todayLine renders sport + run symmetrically with tomorrowLine; focused ITs cover a sport-only day and a gym+sport day; docs/features/companion.md updated
close_reason: get_training_plan renders the date's sport slots; todayLine/tomorrowLine unified into one dayLine; shared ToolText.sportLine; 5 ITs verified red-then-green

title: LLM call audit log (llm_log_history) — decorator-captured, per-call token/cost/entity trail
description: WHY: The Google AI Studio spend dashboard surfaced ~100 Gemini calls/day with zero server-side visibility into which feature/model/entity drove them (the cost scare that triggered this). We have NO central record of what we actually send/receive — debugging a bad LLM turn, attributing cost, or auditing calls all require reconstructing from logs we don't keep. WHAT: An append-only llm_log_history table capturing EVERY LLM call (chat/vision/tool/smart via CompanionLlm + embeddings via EmbeddingPort + proactive crons) in one table with a call_kind discriminator. Captured via two @Primary decorator adapters (LoggingCompanionLlm, LoggingEmbeddingPort) wrapping the real Gemini adapters — reading the REAL served modelVersion + usageMetadata token breakdown from ChatResponse (which .call().content() currently discards). Async non-blocking write (ApplicationEvent -> @Async @EventListener, own REQUIRES_NEW tx, success AND error), stream-end capture for SSE. Cost stored honestly: full token breakdown + a frozen price-snapshot (jsonb) from a mezo.llm-log.pricing config table, cost_usd computed from the snapshot so it never drifts. Entity-level attribution: user+call_kind automatic (principal + port method), feature/operation a small caller tag, entity_kind/entity_id optional. Feature switch mezo.feature.llm-log.enabled (off -> no decorator, zero overhead). INSERT-only (deliberate deviation from the is_deleted house default — audit rows are never mutated). v1 = DB table only (psql/SQL); read-API/UI + retention pruning are later/separate. Design spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-28-llm-call-audit-log-design.md

title: Fuel/Profil NaN: deployed backend version-skew (régi kód szolgálja ki az új FE-t)
description:
A deployed PWA-n a Profil oldal Alaphő·NEAT és Betábl. mozgás mezői NaN-t mutatnak, a Fuel 'Mai cél' kártyáról eltűnt az Alaphő/Mozgás/Deficit bontás.

Gyökérok (kód-szinten cáfolhatatlan): a deployed FRONTEND az új mezo-eujg build (az Alap-TDEE split kártyát rendereli: Alaphő·NEAT / Betábl. mozgás / Fenntartó·Katch), de a deployed BACKEND még RÉGI, mezo-eujg (dc040749) ELŐTTI kódot futtat. A régi TdeeBootstrap DTO alakja {bmr, tdee, pal, formula, computedAt}; az új {bmr, neat, neatBaselineKcal, weeklyEatKcalPerDay, tdee, formula, computedAt}.

Bizonyíték: nincs sem @JsonInclude(NON_NULL) a generált DTO-n, sem globális default-property-inclusion=non_null → új kód a null mezőt is kiírná ("neatBaselineKcal": null → FE Math.round(null)=0). A képen NaN (=undefined=hiányzó kulcs) → a backend válaszban NINCS is neatBaselineKcal → régi backend-kód. tdee=2935 (régi mező) még jön. Fuel: neat=undefined → deriveDailyBudget statikus ágra esik → activity=0,balance=0 → staticEnergy=true → a chipek elrejtve.

A jelenlegi kód (main/0.132.0) HELYES; a k8s manifest mezo-backend:0.132.0-ra mutat (új kód), de a FUTÓ backend pod nyilván nem az → ArgoCD sync / rollout akadt el (valószínűleg új pod nem Ready: OOM 1Gi limit / Liquibase migráció / ImagePull). A GoalReevaluateRunner (@Profile demodata) induláskor újraértékeli az owner-goalt és friss tdeeBootstrap-ot ír — tehát ha az új backend pod elindul, magától reconcile-ódik, kézi evaluate nélkül.

Fix: a mezo namespace-ben ki kell deríteni, miért nem fut a backend:0.132.0 pod, és el kell indítani. Nincs kubectl kontextus a fejlesztői session-ben — a diagnózis a user gépén futó kubectl-t igényel.
notes:
CONFIRMED root cause (via kubectl over Tailscale): NOT ops-only — a real release bug.

Live cluster state: backend Deployment desired image 0.132.0, but the RUNNING/Ready pod was the OLD 0.130.0 RS; the 0.132.0 pod was CrashLoopBackOff (162 restarts / 13h). ArgoCD app = Synced/Degraded.

Crash cause (0.132.0 boot log): com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.exc.UnrecognizedPropertyException: Unrecognized field 'pal' (class TdeeBootstrapJson) ... FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES. The live goal.tdee_bootstrap jsonb still held the OLD shape {bmr,pal,tdee,formula,computedAt}. dc040749 (mezo-eujg) renamed pal->neat + added neatBaselineKcal/weeklyEatKcalPerDay on the record but (a) did NOT add @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true) and (b) shipped no data migration. GoalReevaluateRunner (the intended self-heal) can't run because reading the stale goal to re-evaluate it IS the crash. Catch-22. Local didn't crash because its tdee_bootstrap was NULL.

RESOLUTION (Part A, prod unblocked + VERIFIED): pg_dump backup of goal table taken (scratchpad goal-table-backup-20260727-live.sql + restore-tdee snippet). Then: UPDATE goal SET tdee_bootstrap=NULL WHERE tdee_bootstrap ? 'pal'  (hit 2 rows: active + 1 soft-deleted). Deleted the crashlooping pod -> 0.132.0 booted in 22s, rolled out successfully, old 0.130.0 gone. Log: 'Re-evaluated 1 non-archived owner goal(s)'. DB + GET /api/goals now return fresh {bmr,neat,neatBaselineKcal,weeklyEatKcalPerDay,tdee,formula}. NaN gone; Fuel dynamic breakdown restored. TDEE 2935->3763 (expected: new model adds weeklyEat explicitly).

title: Supplement w/o dose blocks pantry edit (400) + recipe ingredient amount not typeable

title: Running block currentWeek=0 → 'aktuális hét nincs a tervben' for a plan starting today

title: Builder shell layout: sticky breadcrumb double-offset (overlaps header) + content bleeds under translucent tab bar
description: Two layout bugs visible on the run builder (and shared by all .sticky-top builders: Running/Meso builder+planner, ActiveWorkout). (1) .sticky-top { top: 54px } stacks on top of .screen-content { padding-top: 54px }, so the breadcrumb pins ~54px BELOW the status bar instead of directly under it (measured: content top 63px, breadcrumb 117px); because it drops out of its flow position the following header (eyebrow+title) overlaps it on scroll -> 'szétcsúszik'. Fix: .sticky-top top 54px->0 (default + the safe-area media query at ~line 329), since the scrollport already starts below the status bar/notch via padding-top. (2) .tab-bar background rgba(10,15,20,0.75) is too translucent, so the teal bottom CTA bleeds through the tab bar while scrolling ('bemegy a menü alá'); padding-bottom:96px DOES stop the content above the bar at the very end (CTA bottom 813 < tab-bar top 853). Fix: raise the tab-bar background opacity so content fades behind it (keep the blur). Verify with Playwright that all 5 sticky-top screens + a normal screen still look right.
close_reason: Fixed in prototype.css: .sticky-top top 54px->0 (default + safe-area media query) removes the double status-bar offset so the breadcrumb pins directly under the status bar and the header no longer overlaps it; .tab-bar background 0.75->0.92 so scrolling content (teal CTA) fades behind the bar instead of bleeding through. Verified with Playwright on the live builder (breadcrumb top 63 = status bar bottom; header below; CTA absorbed by bar). 377 FE tests x2 modes + build green.

title: Fix: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading weeks)' crash creating a new run plan (REAL mode)
description: Creating a new run plan crashes the builder at RunWeekEditor.tsx:30 (structure.weeks.find on undefined). Root cause: createBlock -> saveRunningBlock(null,newDraft) -> runningApi.create; real-mode saveMutation.onSuccess only invalidate() (async refetch, no synchronous cache insert), then navigates to /train/futas/:id immediately; builder mounts on a stale list -> block undefined -> draft {} -> RunWeekEditor renders with structure undefined and throws. Mock mode is immune (upsertMock setQueryData synchronous). Fix: create onSuccess does qc.setQueryData(['running','blocks']) synchronously in real mode too; builder guards missing structure (loading state); RunWeekEditor/RunSessionCard guard structure?.weeks. Add a create->builder IT/regression test. Shipped together with the redesign but is an independent fix.

title: Backend stack: Java/Spring Boot (not Supabase-direct)
description: DECISION (leaning, finalize at Phase 2). Backend = Java/Spring Boot instead of the handoff's Supabase-direct default. Rationale: solo dev is a Spring Boot expert; the domain is heavy (mesocycle volume calc w/ provenance, pattern engine, cross-load, ~69 entities, scheduled jobs) and fits Spring's strengths (JPA/Hibernate, Liquibase, Spring Security JWT, @Scheduled/Quartz, transactions). Phase 2: frontend mock-hooks swap to Spring Boot REST API -> Postgres (same hook interface; frontend unchanged). Phase 3 AI: Spring AI (multi-provider LLM, pgvector vector store, RAG, function calling, chat memory); optional Python sidecar only if multi-agent graph orchestration gets complex. Deploy: Vercel (frontend) + Spring Boot container on Cloud Run (scale-to-zero) + managed Postgres (Neon/Supabase-DB). Trade-off accepted: lose all-serverless-free simplicity; re-derive schema in Liquibase/JPA from 04-data-model + Phase-3 arch doc instead of using handoff Supabase DDL/RLS/Edge blueprints. Does NOT affect Phase 1 (mock). Repo structure (root frontend vs frontend/+backend/ split) to be decided at Phase 2.

title: S2 spec: resolve stale-evidence-on-old-CLEAR-row before fixing the read endpoint
description: Spec section 4.1 shows CLEAR rendering today's observed value (e.g. 'alvas 6,8 h atlag'), but section 4.3's transition-only write rule deliberately excludes evidence from the change comparison (correct design - verified in S1 Task 4 review). Consequence: a rule sitting CLEAR for two weeks stores the evidence from the day it BECAME CLEAR, not today's value. S2's 'closing state' read will show a possibly-stale observed number next to a live-looking threshold. Coherent design ('unchanged since'), but the spec's rendering example implies freshness it won't have - resolve before S2's endpoint shape is fixed. Found in S1 final review (mezo-6269.1).

title: Isolate FlagTraceWriter.record in its own transaction (REQUIRES_NEW)
description: traceWriter.record(...) currently runs inside evaluateAndLog's @Transactional, so a future constraint violation in the observer (e.g. a >32-char reason code, or a bad FlagKey on a new rule) would roll back the raise, the companion_flag_log row, and the card. Nothing triggers it today, but it inverts the documented 'the write path never fails its caller' principle. A try/catch does NOT work here (a JPA constraint violation poisons the transaction at flush) — needs REQUIRES_NEW on record(). Design decision, deserves its own discussion. Found in S1 final review (mezo-6269.1).

title: Szokás-formálódás nézet: hol tartunk az automatizmus felé (habit detail + előzmény)
description:
IGÉNY (Daniel, 2026-09-05)
Ma nem látszik, hogy egy szokással HOL TARTUNK: mennyire formálódik, milyen úton, mennyi
idő/ismétlés kell még ahhoz, hogy természetesen menjen. A /me/rutin/szokas/{habitKey} oldalon
(és egy előzmény-felületen) mutassuk ezt meg. NEM a "klasszikus 30 nap" sablon kell, hanem egy
dinamikus, a felhasználó SAJÁT adataiból számolt becslés.

MI VAN MA
- habit_day sorok szokásonként, naponta (done/missed/pending), a def létrejötte óta.
- HabitStrength.strengthPct = done/(done+missed) a 28 napos ablakban, plusz done28/missed28.
- A /me/rutin hub statstripje 30 napos tökéletes-nap SZÁMLÁLÓKAT mutat (nem naptárt).
- A HabitPage ma a recept szerkesztője (keret, horgony, szüneteltetés) — nincs rajta semmilyen
  formálódás-nézet.
Vagyis: van napi eseménytörténet, de nincs sem lefutás-görbe, sem becslés, és a 28 napos ablak
levágja a hosszabb ívet.

SZAKMAI ALAP (a brainstorm recon feladata pontosítani/frissíteni)
A "21 nap" városi legenda. Lally és mtsai (2010, European Journal of Social Psychology) mérése
szerint az automatizmus ASZIMPTOTIKUSAN nő az ISMÉTLÉSEK számával, a medián ~66 nap, az egyéni
szórás 18-254 nap, és egy kihagyott alkalom érdemben nem töri meg a folyamatot. A jó modell
tehát nem naptári nap, hanem: ismétlésszám AZONOS KONTEXTUSBAN, telítődő görbével
(automatizmus ≈ A * (1 - e^(-k*n))), ahol k a felhasználó saját konzisztenciájából becsülhető.
A kontextus-állandóság (ugyanaz a napszak, ugyanaz a horgony) a legerősebb prediktor — ezt mi
tudjuk mérni, mert a defnek van daypartja és anchor_habit_key-e.

AMIT MUTATNI KELL (javaslat, a design körben véglegesítendő)
- Hol tartunk a görbén: az eddigi sikeres ismétlések száma és a becsült automatizmus-szint.
- Mennyi van hátra: becsült további ismétlés/idő a "természetesen megy" küszöbig, a SAJÁT
  ritmusból számolva (heti hány alkalom valósul meg), nem fix 30/66 napból.
- Az ív: a lefutás az első naptól (nem 28 napos ablak), a kihagyások láthatók, de nem nulláznak.
- A kontextus-állandóság, mint minőségi jelző (mennyire ugyanabban a napszakban/horgony után
  történik).

FIGYELEM — MEGLÉVŐ TERMÉKDÖNTÉS, AMIT NEM SZABAD CSENDBEN FELÜLÍRNI
A docs/design_2.0/2026-09-02-rutin-epito-design-iterations.md §3 kimondja: "strength bars, no
streak resets" — a piros X / megtört lánc mechanika növeli a lemorzsolódást (ADR 0010: nincs
piros, a visszajelzés nem büntetés). A tétel címében szereplő "streak oldal" tehát NEM
klasszikus streak-számláló legyen: a formálódás-nézet az automatizmus felé vezető utat mutassa,
a kihagyás pedig lassítson, ne nullázzon. Ha mégis streak-számot akarunk, az tudatos
felülbírálás, és a design-iterations docban kell rögzíteni.

HATÓKÖR (várhatóan)
- Backend: aggregálás a def teljes élettartamára (első habit_day sortól), nem 28 napos ablakra;
  a becslő tiszta, tesztelhető függvényként (nem SQL-be rejtve).
- Kontraktus: új végpont vagy a summary bővítése (kapcsolódik: mezo-11nm, ami napi biteket +
  perfectStreak-et kérne; érdemes EGYÜTT tervezni, hogy ne két külön aggregátum szülessen).
- FE: a HabitPage formálódás-blokkja + az előzmény-felület; a Mozaik nyelvén.

ELŐFELTÉTEL: design kör (superpowers:brainstorming + brainstorm-recon), mert a becslő modell
megválasztása és a megjelenítés is termékdöntés. A recon feladata: friss szakirodalom (Lally
utáni munkák, pl. nagy mintás edzés-adherencia vizsgálatok) + prior art (Loop Habit Tracker
score/automatizmus-modellje, Atoms "repetitions", Habitify Progress).

SORREND: a mezo-3zue.6 és a mezo-x9c2 UTÁN érdemes nekiállni — előbbi a horgony-kontextust
teszi valóságossá (amit ez a nézet mérni akar), utóbbi pedig a hiányzó napok pótlását, ami
közvetlenül torzítja a görbét.

title: Flaky: CompanionToolsRenderIT medication cycle-day test is wall-clock dependent
description:
`CompanionToolsRenderIT.testGetMedication_shouldRenderGeneralOverview_whenScopeAll` seeds a dose at `LocalDate.now().minusDays(3)` but asserts a hardcoded cycle day: `.contains("ciklus: 4. nap (Stabil)")`. The rendered cycle day is derived from the medication's own start reference, so the computed day shifts with the wall clock and the assertion goes stale.

Observed failing during S6's full-suite gate (2026-09-05, just after midnight):

```
Expecting actual:
  "Gyógyszer: Teszt gyógyszer (teszthatoanyag) — weekly, 6 mg; ciklus: 3. nap (Stabil)
Utolsó dózisok: 2026-09-02: 4 mg"
to contain:
  "ciklus: 4. nap (Stabil)"
```

Nothing in S6 touches medication — this is pre-existing and unrelated to that slice; it simply bit when the date rolled over mid-session. Same family as the other midnight-straddle flakes already filed (mezo-8d37, mezo-phib).

Fix: derive the expected cycle day from the same reference the renderer uses (or pin the fixture's dates to fixed values rather than `LocalDate.now()`), so the assertion cannot drift with the calendar.
close_reason: Javítva és mergelve (PR #471): a gyökér-ok prod zóna-inkonzisztencia volt (getDay: UTC, MedicationTools: default zóna) — egységesítve MedicationCycleService.MEDICATION_ZONE (Europe/Budapest) + deriveToday; a két IT ugyanabból a referenciából seedel/assertál. Bizonyíték: TZ=Etc/GMT+12 alatt a régi kód '5. nap'-ot adott '4. nap' helyett; a fix után 3-zónás mátrix zöld. A snapshot-assembler saját-dátumos útvonala follow-up: mezo-ned9.

title: Make the FlagKey mirrors self-policing with a reflection test
description:
S6's Task-2 review (2026-09-04) noted that nothing automatically ties FlagKey to the two @Pattern regexes or the ck_companion_flag_log_flag_key DB CHECK. Every key batch so far has required a manual five-way enumeration, and three of those mirrors fail only at runtime (the CooldownHours.forFlag default throws inside a listener's catch; Bean Validation rejects before the DB CHECK; the Intervention.flag regex fails at Spring context startup).

Proposal: a reflection test asserting that the set of alternatives in CompanionFlagLogEntity.flagKey's @Pattern regex, and in CompanionProperties.Intervention.flag's @Pattern regex, each EQUALS the set of public static String constants on FlagKey (excluding SOURCE_*). That makes mirrors 4 and 5 self-policing for every future batch. The DB CHECK cannot be reflected over, but a persistence IT that iterates the FlagKey constants and rawInserts each one would make mirror 3 self-policing too — today that IT hardcodes the key list.

Precedent to follow: AdvicePriorityTest already does exactly this shape for the severity table (reflection over FlagKey, assert every constant has a rank).

Context: this is the epic's single most repeated defect class — see the PROCESS NOTE comments on mezo-d58h.

title: S5 gap: five date-specific FE sport read paths ignore sport_slot_skip
description:
S5's whole-branch review (2026-09-04) found that the FE week agenda got the sport-slot skip filter but five other date-specific FE read paths did not:

- frontend/src/features/fuel/logic/buildProtocol.ts (~line 42) — sessions.filter(s => s.today && s.time) builds today's sport block, driving the pre-workout meal anchor and the calorie budget
- frontend/src/data/today/todayHooks.ts (~line 152) — volleyballSessions for the Today hero
- frontend/src/features/today/logic/useDayOrbFill.ts (~line 55)
- frontend/src/data/ritual/recapHooks.ts (~line 66) — sessions.find(s => s.today)
- frontend/src/data/fuel/fuelWeekHooks.ts (~line 131)

This is a coherence seam, not just a gap: the backend's WorkoutWindowQueryService.hasScheduledTrainingOn DOES honour the skip, so the fuel DAY-TYPE comes back "not a training day" while the FE fuel PROTOCOL still renders the sport block. Two halves of one feature disagreeing about the same day is exactly the failure the six backend read-path changes were written to prevent.

Nothing user-visible breaks today: AdviceActionCatalog cannot offer skip_sport_slot in round 1, so no skip row can exist. **This BLOCKS S6 (mezo-d58h.6)** — when a round-2 rule starts offering the action, the gap ships silently.

Pattern to follow: frontend/src/features/train/logic/weekAgenda.ts already takes a `skips` param and filters on (day, time, date); the query key is sportSlotSkipsQueryKey() in frontend/src/data/train/trainHooks.ts.

title: Kamra: a pkg/price/priceUnit tovabbra is 0-t es ures stringet allit NULL helyett - a definicio-echo hibacsalad OTODIK esete
description:

- .pkg(c.getPackageLabel() == null ? "" : ...) es .priceUnit(... ? "" : ...) - a NULL ures stringkent.

A pkg DEFINICIOS mezo, es a definitionDiffers igy hasonlit: r.getPkg() != null && !r.getPkg().equals(c.getPackageLabel()). Egy visszakuldott "" egy NULL package_label mellett DIFFERS-t ad - pontosan az a 403 / nema megosztott-sor-felulíras, amit a mezo-4orh es a mezo-6omv kiirtott.

Ma csak azert nem robban, mert a FE ket helyen esetlegesen elejti: inputFromItem 'if (item.pkg)' (a falsy "" kiesik) es AddPantryItemSheet put('pkg', initial?.pkg). Ez VELETLEN vedelem, nem szandekos szerzodes - barmely masik kliens (Hermes/companion, egy jovobeli mobil) 403-at kap.

A price az allapot-felere esik (sajat polc-sor), ezert nem 403-azik, de a hatas valos: egy ar nelkuli tetel barmely szerkesztese utan a price_huf NULL-bol 0 lesz, es a detail oldal {item.price ? ... : '—'} igy '—'-t ir 0 Ft helyett, mikozben a DB-ben mar 0 all.

Lelet: a 2026-09-04-i Kamra-utokovetes koteg zaro branch-review-jabol (mezo-4orh koteg). A koteg scope-jabol tudatosan kimaradt.

Javaslat: ugyanaz a minta, mint a mezo-6omv-nel - a kontraktus legyen oszinte (nullable price/pkg/priceUnit), a FE szamolo fogyasztoi essenek vissza a sajat hatarukon, a megjelenitok irjanak '—'-t.

Ez a port NINCS worktree-nként elkülönítve, tehát ha egy MÁSIK git worktree (vagy egy másik ügynök-session) hagyott ott futó vite szervert, a Playwright csendben AHHOZ csatlakozik — és a goldenek a MÁSIK fa UI-járól készülnek.

Javaslat: a port ne legyen fix — vagy 0-ás (efemer) port + a Playwright saját webServer-e, vagy a worktree útvonalából származtatott port, vagy legalább 'reuseExistingServer: false' CI-n kívül is. Ha marad a reuse, a konfig ELLENŐRIZZE, hogy a talált szerver ehhez a fához tartozik (pl. egy /__worktree health-végponton), és álljon le hangosan, ha nem.
